verdict.rationale: Notte documents an authenticated REST API that covers its core surfaces: creating and controlling cloud browser sessions, scraping, running web agents, and deploying functions as API endpoints. Live viewing is also exposed through a ViewerUrl returned when a session starts. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates API–UI parity, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of full UI/API parity, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage for dashboard-only features (templates, replays, profiles/identities management), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: used to create cloud browser sessions, scrape webpages, and run web ai agents to act on your behalf on the internet
Sessions are isolated browser instances running in the cloud that you can control programmatically.
All API requests require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
Deploy your scripts as API endpoints.
When you start a session, the output includes a `ViewerUrl` - open it to watch your browser live
